  (c R T t : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (htau0 : tau 0 = 0) (htime : ∀ k < L, tau k < tau (k + 1)) (hT : tau L ≤ T) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
  (hbranch :
    ∀ k < L,
      AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.closedBranch r (tau (k + 1)) (pre k)) (tau k)
        (tau (k + 1)))
  (hkappa : IntervalIntegrable kappa MeasureTheory.volume 0 T)
  (hgamma : IntervalIntegrable gamma MeasureTheory.volume 0 T) (hr : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ r u)
  (hgamma_nonneg : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ gamma u)
  (hpos :
    ∀ k < L,
      ∀ᵐ (u : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioo (tau k) (tau (k + 1))),
        ↑u < PaperFormalization.Manuscript.exitTime r R T →
          0 < r u → deriv r u ≤ -kappa u * r u + c * r u ^ 2 + gamma u * r u + gamma u)
  (hJ : ∀ k < L, 0 ≤ J k)
  (hjump : ∀ k < L, ↑(tau (k + 1)) ≤ PaperFormalization.Manuscript.exitTime r R T → r (tau (k + 1)) ≤ J k * pre k + b k)
  (hfinal : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval r (tau L) T)
  (hpos_final :
    ∀ᵐ (u : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioo (tau L) T),
      ↑u < PaperFormalization.Manuscript.exitTime r R T →
        0 < r u → deriv r u ≤ -kappa u * r u + c * r u ^ 2 + gamma u * r u + gamma u)
  (hzero : r 0 = 0) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htT : t ≤ T) (htExit : ↑t ≤ PaperFormalization.Manuscript.exitTime r R T) :
  r t ≤
    (∫ (v : ℝ) in 0..t,
        (PaperFormalization.Continuous.propagator (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.stoppedCoefficient kappa gamma c R) t
              v *
            ∏ k ∈ Finset.range L with v < tau (k + 1) ∧ tau (k + 1) ≤ t, J k) *
          gamma v) +
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range L with tau (i + 1) ≤ t,
        (PaperFormalization.Continuous.propagator (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.stoppedCoefficient kappa gamma c R) t
              (tau (i + 1)) *
            ∏ k ∈ Finset.range L with tau (i + 1) < tau (k + 1) ∧ tau (k + 1) ≤ t, J k) *
          b i

  [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (X Y : ℝ → E) (V : E → E) (w : E) (H : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E)

  (hV : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, HasFDerivAt V (-H s) (Y t + s • (X t - Y t)))

  (hquad :
    ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 1,

  (hgrowth :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : E),
      ∀ k ≤ 2,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (φ n) x‖ ≤ PaperFormalization.Manuscript.featureGrowth C g q n * (1 + ‖x‖ ^ (n + 1 - k)))
  (P : Set (MeasureTheory.Measure E)) (D : ℝ) (G : ↥(lp H 2) → ℝ) (U : Set ↥(lp H 2)) (hU : IsOpen U)
  (hSU :
    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.measureMomentRegion (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceWeightedFeatureMap c p φ) P
        D ⊆
      U)
  (hG : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 G U) (X Y : PiLp 2 fun x => E) (hX : ∀ (i : ι), ‖X.ofLp i‖ ≤ D)
  (hY : ∀ (i : ι), ‖Y.ofLp i‖ ≤ D) :

    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.empiricalConfigurationField J
      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.momentGradientField (fderiv ℝ J) (gradient G));

    ContinuousOn B (Set.Icc 0 1) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun s => (B s) (X - Y)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 ∧
        V X - V Y = -∫ (s : ℝ) in 0..1, (B s) (X - Y)

PaperFormalization.Manuscript.source_ode_ae_drift.{u_1, u_2} {E : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] {H : ℕ → Type u_2}
  [(n : ℕ) → NormedAddCommGroup (H n)] [(n : ℕ) → InnerProductSpace ℝ (H n)] [∀ (n : ℕ), CompleteSpace (H n)] {N : ℕ}
  (c C g p q K D alpha C3 : ℝ) (φ : (n : ℕ) → E → H n) (hc : 0 < c) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hp : 1 < p) (hq : q < p) (hK : 0 < K)
  (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hφ : ∀ (n : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ 2 (φ n))
  (hgrowth :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : E),
      ∀ k ≤ 2,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (φ n) z‖ ≤ PaperFormalization.Manuscript.featureGrowth C g q n * (1 + ‖z‖ ^ (n + 1 - k)))
  (hthirdφ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : E), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (φ n))) z)
  (hgrowth₃ :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : E),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (φ n) z‖ ≤ PaperFormalization.Manuscript.featureGrowth C g q n * (1 + ‖z‖ ^ (n + 1 - 3)))
  (G : ↥(lp H 2) → ℝ) (U : Set ↥(lp H 2)) (hU : IsOpen U)
  (hSU :
    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.measureMomentRegion (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceWeightedFeatureMap c p φ)
        (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceMomentClass alpha K) D ⊆
      U)
  (hG : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 G U)
  (hthirdG :
    ∀
      theta ∈
        PaperFormalization.Manuscript.measureMomentRegion (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceWeightedFeatureMap c p φ)
          (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceMomentClass alpha K) D,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 G theta‖ ≤ C3)
  (L : NNReal) (hL : ↑L = PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceComparisonEnvelope c C g p q K D alpha C3 φ G)
  (mu : ℝ → MeasureTheory.Measure E) (X Y : ℝ → PiLp 2 fun x => E) (a b A_sp : ℝ) (hN : 0 < N)
  (hgood :
    ∀ᵐ (t : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b),
      mu t ∈ PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceMomentClass alpha K ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin N), ‖(X t).ofLp i‖ ≤ D) ∧
          (∀ (i : Fin N), ‖(Y t).ofLp i‖ ≤ D) ∧
            (↑N)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖(X t - Y t).ofLp i‖ ^ 3 ≤ A_sp * (‖X t - Y t‖ / √↑N) ^ 3 ∧
              HasDerivAt X
                  (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.empiricalConfigurationField
                    (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceWeightedFeatureMap c p φ)
                    (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.momentGradientField
                      (fderiv ℝ (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceWeightedFeatureMap c p φ)) (gradient G))
                    (X t))
                  t ∧
                HasDerivAt Y
                  (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.frozenMomentConfigurationField
                    (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.momentGradientField
                      (fderiv ℝ (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceWeightedFeatureMap c p φ)) (gradient G))
                    (∫ (z : E), PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceWeightedFeatureMap c p φ z ∂mu t) (Y t))
                  t) :
  have J := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceWeightedFeatureMap c p φ;
  have r := fun t => ‖X t - Y t‖ / √↑N;
  have kappa := fun t =>
    PaperFormalization.Continuous.rayleighInf
      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sampledMomentHessian J G (∫ (z : E), J z ∂mu t) (Y t));
  have Gamma :=
    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.momentResidual (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.featureResidualWeight c p L)
      (fun n t => PaperFormalization.Manuscript.finiteFeatureMean fun i => φ n ((Y t).ofLp i)) fun n t =>
      ∫ (z : E), φ n z ∂mu t;
  ∀ᵐ (t : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b),
    deriv r t ≤
      -kappa t * r t +
            (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.featureDisplacementLambda c C g p q D L + (2 + A_sp) * ↑L) * r t ^ 2 +

            p ≤ 1 →

                ↑N ^ (-Cp) ≤ p →
                  have x := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceGammaScale N J T B (3 * p / 8);
                  ∀ (A delta deltaTilde cD : ℝ) (kappa : ℝ → ℝ) (tau eta : ℕ → ℝ),
                    0 ≤ A →
                      0 ≤ cD →
                        A ≤ Ca * x ^ theta →
                          cD ≤ Cd * x ^ theta →
                            delta ≤ Cg * x ^ theta * ((√↑N)⁻¹ + T / ↑N) →
                              deltaTilde ≤ Ct * x ^ theta * (√↑N)⁻¹ →
                                (∀ i < J, 0 ≤ eta i ∧ eta i ≤ C0) →
                                  (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
                                      ∫ (s : ℝ) in 0..t, PaperFormalization.Continuous.propagator kappa t s ≤
                                        C0 * ↑N ^ nu * (1 + T)) →
                                    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
                                        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range J with tau (i + 1) ≤ t,
                                            eta i * PaperFormalization.Continuous.propagator kappa t (tau (i + 1)) ≤
                                          C0 * ↑N ^ nu) →
                                      T *
                                          (delta +
                                            cD *
                                              (2 *
                                                  PaperFormalization.Manuscript.jumpAmplification
                                                    (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceJumpError A eta) J *
                                                PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceCurvatureEnvelopeSup kappa tau eta
                                                  delta deltaTilde A J T)) ≤
                                        1 / 4

PaperFormalization.Manuscript.eventually_source_population_coefficient_smallness.{u_1, u_2} {E : Type u_1} [Zero E]
  {H : ℕ → Type u_2} [(n : ℕ) → NormedAddCommGroup (H n)] [(n : ℕ) → InnerProductSpace ℝ (H n)] (d : ℕ)
  (c C g pDecay q alpha C3 A_sp K0 CD : ℝ) (φ : (n : ℕ) → E → H n) (G : ↥(lp H 2) → ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
  (hpDecay : 1 < pDecay) (hq : q < pDecay) (halpha : 0 < alpha) (hA_sp : 0 ≤ A_sp) (hCD : 1 ≤ CD) (L0 : ℝ) (B : NNReal)
  (Cp theta nu zeta Cg Ct C0 : ℝ) (hL0 : 0 ≤ L0) (htheta : 0 < theta) (hnu : 0 ≤ nu) (hzeta : 0 < zeta) (hCg : 0 ≤ Cg)
  (hCt : 0 ≤ Ct) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hexp : (5 / 4 + Cp) * (L0 + 5 / 2) * theta ≤ zeta / 2) :
  ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
    ∀ (J : ℕ) (T p : ℝ),
      ↑J ≤ L0 →
        0 ≤ T →
          0 < p →
            p ≤ 1 →
              T ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 4 - nu - zeta) →
                ↑N ^ (-Cp) ≤ p →
                  have x := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceGammaScale N J T (↑B) (3 * p / 8);
                  have b := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourcePopulationExponentialScale alpha K0;
                  have A0 := 4 * ↑(PaperFormalization.Manuscript.populationGridBudget B J T) / (p / 8);
                  have K :=
                    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceExponentialMomentCoefficient alpha *
                      PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourcePopulationNormalizedScale alpha b A0;
                  have D := CD * (1 + Real.log x) ^ (1 / alpha);
                  ∀ (L : NNReal),
                    ↑L = PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceComparisonEnvelope c C g pDecay q K D alpha C3 φ G →
                      have Lambda := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.featureDisplacementLambda c C g pDecay q D L;
                      have A :=
                        PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceJumpCoefficient d Lambda ↑L *
                          PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceGaussianDeviation (p / (8 * (↑J + 1)));
                      have cD := Lambda + (2 + A_sp) * ↑L;
                      ∀ (delta deltaTilde : ℝ) (kappa : ℝ → ℝ) (tau eta : ℕ → ℝ),
                        delta ≤ Cg * x ^ theta * ((√↑N)⁻¹ + T / ↑N) →
                          deltaTilde ≤ Ct * x ^ theta * (√↑N)⁻¹ →
                            (∀ i < J, 0 ≤ eta i ∧ eta i ≤ C0) →
                              (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
                                  ∫ (s : ℝ) in 0..t, PaperFormalization.Continuous.propagator kappa t s ≤
                                    C0 * ↑N ^ nu * (1 + T)) →
                                (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
                                    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range J with tau (i + 1) ≤ t,
                                        eta i * PaperFormalization.Continuous.propagator kappa t (tau (i + 1)) ≤
                                      C0 * ↑N ^ nu) →
                                  T *
                                      (delta +
                                        cD *
                                          (2 *
                                              PaperFormalization.Manuscript.jumpAmplification
                                                (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceJumpError A eta) J *
                                            PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceCurvatureEnvelopeSup kappa tau eta delta
                                              deltaTilde A J T)) ≤
                                    1 / 4

PaperFormalization.Manuscript.exists_source_constructed_population_event.{u_1, u_2} {O : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2}
  [MeasurableSpace O] [MeasurableSpace S] (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure O) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
  (environment : O → S) (henvironment : Measurable environment) (J d : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (a btime : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ)
  (B : NNReal) (hab : ∀ (j : Fin (J + 1)), a j ≤ btime j) (hlen : ∑ j, (btime j - a j) ≤ T) (alpha K p0 : ℝ)
  (halpha : 0 < alpha) (hK : 0 < K) (hp0 : 0 < p0) (hp01 : p0 ≤ 1)
  (Z : Fin 2 → Fin (J + 1) → O → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
  (hZ : ∀ (c : Fin 2) (j : Fin (J + 1)) (t : ℝ), Measurable fun x => Z c j x t)
  (hclass :
    ∀ (c : Fin 2) (i : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.PopulationGridLabel B J a btime),
      MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun x => Z c i.fst x (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.populationGridTime B J a btime i))
          nu ∈
        PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceMomentClass alpha K)
  (hLip : ∀ᵐ (x : O) ∂nu, ∀ (c : Fin 2) (j : Fin (J + 1)), LipschitzOnWith B (Z c j x) (Set.Icc (a j) (btime j)))
  (Model : O → Prop) (hModel : ∀ᵐ (x : O) ∂nu, Model x) :
  ∃ paths,
    Measurable paths ∧
      (∀ᵐ (x : O) ∂nu,
          ∀ (c : Fin 2) (j : Fin (J + 1)),
            ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (a j) (btime j),
              PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourcePopulationPathEval (paths x) c j t = Z c j x t) ∧
        have law := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.originalConditionalPathLaw nu environment paths;
        have b := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourcePopulationExponentialScale alpha K;
        have A0 := 4 * ↑(PaperFormalization.Manuscript.populationGridBudget B J T) / p0;
        have kpop := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourcePopulationNormalizedScale alpha b A0;
        have Kpop := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceExponentialMomentCoefficient alpha * kpop;
        MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun x => (environment x, paths x)) nu =
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.map environment nu).compProd law ∧
          ∃ PopGood,
            MeasurableSet PopGood ∧
              (MeasureTheory.Measure.map environment nu).real PopGoodᶜ ≤ p0 ∧
                (∀ h ∈ PopGood,
                    ∀ (c : Fin 2) (j : Fin (J + 1)),
                      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (a j) (btime j),
                        MeasureTheory.Integrable
                            (fun path =>
                              Real.exp
                                (‖PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourcePopulationPathEval path c j t‖ ^ alpha /
                                  (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourcePopulationFlowFactor alpha * b ^ alpha)))
                            (law h) ∧

  (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure O) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
  (mu0 : MeasureTheory.Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu0]

  (hinit : Measurable initial) (hInnovation : ∀ (k : ℕ), Measurable (innovation k))

PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineCoupling_comparison_regularities {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
  (rho : MeasureTheory.Measure (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.SourceFiniteConfiguration N 1))
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure rho] (a beta tau eta T R : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ beta) (htau : 0 ≤ tau)
  (hT : tau ≤ T) (heta : 0 ≤ eta) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
  (hU : ∀ᵐ (U : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.SourceFiniteConfiguration N 1) ∂rho, ∀ (i : Fin N), ‖U.ofLp i‖ ≤ R) :
  have law := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineCouplingLaw rho;
  have P := fun w =>
    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosinePairBranch a beta tau eta T w.1 w.2.1
      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineCouplingZeta a beta tau w);
  (∀ k ≤ 1,
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (if k = 0 then 0 else tau) (if k = 0 then tau else T),
        ∀ (i : Fin N),
          MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun w => (P w k t).1.ofLp i) law ∈
              PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceMomentClass 2
                (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineMomentScale a beta R eta) ∧
            MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun w => (P w k t).2.ofLp i) law ∈
              PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceMomentClass 2
                (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineMomentScale a beta R eta)) ∧
    (∀ᵐ (w : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineCouplingSpace N) ∂law,
        ∀ (k : ℕ) (i : Fin N),
          LipschitzOnWith ⟨PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineSpeed a beta R, ⋯⟩ (fun t => (P w k t).1.ofLp i)
              (Set.Icc (if k = 0 then 0 else tau) (if k = 0 then tau else T)) ∧
            LipschitzOnWith ⟨PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineSpeed a beta R, ⋯⟩
              (fun t => (P w k t).2.ofLp i) (Set.Icc (if k = 0 then 0 else tau) (if k = 0 then tau else T))) ∧
      ∀ (w : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineCouplingSpace N),
        PaperFormalization.Manuscript.SourceRightAntiSpikiness (fun t => (P w (if t < tau then 0 else 1) t).1)
          (fun t => (P w (if t < tau then 0 else 1) t).2) T 1

  ∃ Phi,
    (Measurable fun z => Phi z.1 z.2) ∧
      ∀ᵐ (z :
        (ℕ → ℝ) ×

              (fun Z n => PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineInnovation n Z)
              (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1)).prod
          mu0,
        ∀ (j : Fin (1 + 1)),
          ∀
            t ∈
              Set.Icc (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceScheduleLeft times 1 j)
                (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceScheduleRight times 1 T j),

                (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineFlowY a beta tau eta T)

PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosine_response_control {N : ℕ}
  (mu0 : MeasureTheory.Measure PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu0] (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
  (hU : ∀ᵐ (u : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint) ∂mu0, ‖u‖ ≤ R)
  (hm0 : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineMean mu0 = 0) (a beta tau eta T p : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < beta)
  (htau : 0 ≤ tau) (heta : 0 < eta) (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
  have sigma := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineJumpSigma a beta eta;
  have rho :=
    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineEscapeRadius
      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineLandingVariance a beta eta) p;
  have r := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineRecoveryTime beta tau rho;
  have P :=
    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineCouplingLaw
      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceInitialConfigurationLaw mu0);
  have E := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineEscapeEvent sigma rho;
  MeasurableSet E ∧
    P Eᶜ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (p / 2) ∧
      ∀ w ∈ E,
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
            PaperFormalization.Manuscript.recoveryContinuousResponse
                  (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineRightCurvature a beta tau eta T w.2.1) t +
                PaperFormalization.Manuscript.recoveryJumpResponse
                  (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineRightCurvature a beta tau eta T w.2.1) tau eta t ≤
              PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineResponseConstant a beta tau eta / rho) ∧
          (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc r T,
              have k := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineRightCurvature a beta tau eta T w.2.1;
              have b := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineCurvatureScale beta;
              have lam := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineRecoveryRate a beta;
              PaperFormalization.Manuscript.recoveryContinuousResponse k t ≤
                  2 * Real.exp (b * tau) / (rho * b) * Real.exp (-lam * (t - r)) + lam⁻¹ ∧
                PaperFormalization.Manuscript.recoveryJumpResponse k tau eta t ≤
                  2 * eta * Real.exp (b * tau) / rho * Real.exp (-lam * (t - r))) ∧
            ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc r T,
              have pop :=
                PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosinePopulation mu0
                  (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineRightMean a beta tau eta T w.2.1 t) (Real.exp (-a * t));
              MeasureTheory.Integrable PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineEncodedFeature pop ∧
                0 ≤
                    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineObjective a beta
                        (∫ (x : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint),
                          PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineEncodedFeature x ∂pop) +
                      beta ∧
                  PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineObjective a beta
                        (∫ (x : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint),
                          PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineEncodedFeature x ∂pop) +
                      beta ≤
                    (a / 2 * R ^ 2 + 2 * beta) *
                      Real.exp (-2 * PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineRecoveryRate a beta * (t - r))

PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosine_stability_scale_algebra (s P C L delta S A J cD Bstar : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
  (hs1 : s ≤ 1) (hP : 1 ≤ P) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hJ : 0 ≤ J)
  (hcD : 0 ≤ cD) (hB : 0 ≤ Bstar) (hdU : delta ≤ C * s ^ 8 * P) (hSU : S ≤ C * s ^ 4 * P) (hAU : A ≤ C * P)
  (hJU : J ≤ C * P) (hcDU : cD ≤ C * P) (hBU : Bstar ≤ (delta + A * S) * L / s) :
  Bstar ≤ 2 * C ^ 2 * L * s ^ 3 * P ^ 2 ∧
    2 * J * Bstar ≤ 4 * C ^ 3 * L * s ^ 3 * P ^ 3 ∧
      s⁻¹ ^ 2 * (delta + cD * (2 * J * Bstar)) ≤ (C + 4 * C ^ 4 * L) * s * P ^ 4
'PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosine_stability_scale_algebra' depends on axioms: [propext,
 Classical.choice,
 Quot.sound]

  (hloss : loss ≤ K * P ^ 4 * (s ^ 8 * (1 + Cresp) + s ^ 4 * Jresp)) : loss ≤ K * (1 + 2 * L) * s ^ 3 * P ^ 4

PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosine_responses_after_wait (a beta tau eta T Z rho v t : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
  (hb : 0 < beta) (htau : 0 ≤ tau) (heta : 0 ≤ eta) (hr : 0 < rho) (hr1 : rho ≤ 1) (hv : 0 < v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1)
  (hland :
    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineEscapeLanding rho
      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosinePostMeanY a beta eta Z))
  (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineRecoveryTime beta tau rho) T)
  (hwait :
    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineRecoveryTime beta tau rho +
        Real.log (rho * v)⁻¹ / PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineRecoveryRate a beta ≤
      t) :
  have b := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineCurvatureScale beta;
  have lam := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineRecoveryRate a beta;
  have k := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineRightCurvature a beta tau eta T Z;
  PaperFormalization.Manuscript.recoveryContinuousResponse k t ≤ 2 * Real.exp (b * tau) / b + lam⁻¹ ∧
    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.recoveryJumpResponse k tau eta t ≤ 2 * eta * Real.exp (b * tau) * v

PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosine_wait_logarithmic (n d b lam tau : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 0 < d) (hb : b ≠ 0)
  (hl : lam ≠ 0) :
  tau + Real.log (2 / (d * n ^ (-(1 / 16)))) / b + Real.log (d * n ^ (-(1 / 16)) * n ^ (-(1 / 4)))⁻¹ / lam =
    tau + Real.log (2 / d) / b + Real.log d⁻¹ / lam + (1 / (16 * b) + 5 / (16 * lam)) * Real.log n

  (P : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineExampleParameters) {N : ℕ}
  (mu0 : MeasureTheory.Measure PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint) (T : ℝ)

PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExample_source_joint_transport
  (P : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineExampleParameters) {N : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N)
  (mu0 : MeasureTheory.Measure PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu0]
  (hU : ∀ᵐ (u : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint) ∂mu0, ‖u‖ ≤ P.radius)
  (hm : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineMean mu0 = 0) (T : ℝ) (hT : P.tau ≤ T)
  (z : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineExampleTower N) (epsilon M : ℝ) :
  have branches := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleCanonicalBranch P mu0 ⋯ T hT;
  have paths := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleCanonicalRight P mu0 ⋯ T hT;
  have Z := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleCharacteristic P T z;
  have law := fun t =>
    MeasureTheory.Measure.map
      (fun u =>
        PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceGlue (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineTimes P.tau) 1
          (fun k => Z k u) t)
      mu0;
  have preLaw := fun k =>
    MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun u => Z k u (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineTimes P.tau (k + 1))) mu0;
  have kappa := fun t =>
    PaperFormalization.Continuous.rayleighInf
      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sampledMomentHessian PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineEncodedFeature
        (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineObjective P.a P.beta)
        (MeasureTheory.integral (law t) PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineEncodedFeature) (paths z t).2);
  PaperFormalization.Manuscript.SourceJointRateConclusion PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineEncodedFeature
      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineObjective P.a P.beta) law preLaw
      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceGlue (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineTimes P.tau) 1
        (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleRawX P T z))
      (fun t => (paths z t).2)
      (fun k =>
        PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleRawX P T z k
          (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineTimes P.tau (k + 1)))
      (fun k => (branches z k (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineTimes P.tau (k + 1))).2) kappa
      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineTimes P.tau)
      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineAmplitudes P.eta) 1 T
      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleConfidence N) epsilon M →
    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineExampleJointRate P mu0 T
      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineTowerCoordinates z) epsilon M

PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExample_source_tracking_transport
  (P : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineExampleParameters) {N : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N)
  (mu0 : MeasureTheory.Measure PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu0]
  (hU : ∀ᵐ (u : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint) ∂mu0, ‖u‖ ≤ P.radius)
  (hm : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineMean mu0 = 0)
  (hT : P.tau ≤ PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleHorizon N)
  (z : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineExampleTower N) :
  let T := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleHorizon N;
  have branches := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleCanonicalBranch P mu0 ⋯ T hT;
  have paths := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleCanonicalRight P mu0 ⋯ T hT;
  have Z := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleCharacteristic P T z;
  have law := fun t =>
    MeasureTheory.Measure.map
      (fun u =>
        PaperFormalization.Manuscript.sourceGlue (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineTimes P.tau) 1
          (fun k => Z k u) t)
      mu0;
  have kappa := fun t =>
    PaperFormalization.Continuous.rayleighInf

PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleGood_suprema
  (P : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineExampleParameters)
  (mu0 : MeasureTheory.Measure PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu0]
  (hU : ∀ᵐ (u : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint) ∂mu0, ‖u‖ ≤ P.radius)
  (hm : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineMean mu0 = 0) (N : ℕ) (epsilon : ℝ) (he : 0 < epsilon)
  (hN : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleRateCutoff P epsilon he ≤ N)
  (w : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineCouplingSpace N)
  (hw : w ∈ PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleGood P mu0 hU hm N) :
  have T := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleHorizon N;
  have S := P.waitConstant * Real.log ↑N;
  have C := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleRateConstant P epsilon he;
  S < T ∧
    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineExampleActualSmallness P N w ∧
      BddAbove (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleError P mu0 T w '' Set.Icc 0 T) ∧
        sSup (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleError P mu0 T w '' Set.Icc 0 T) ≤
            C * ↑N ^ (-(3 / 16) + epsilon) ∧
          PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExamplePreError P mu0 T w ≤ C * ↑N ^ (-(3 / 16) + epsilon) ∧
            BddAbove (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleLateError P mu0 T w '' Set.Icc S T) ∧
              sSup (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleLateError P mu0 T w '' Set.Icc S T) ≤
                  C * ↑N ^ (-(1 / 2) + epsilon) ∧
                ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc S T,
                  0 ≤
                    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineEmpiricalExcess P
                      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExamplePair P T w t).1

 Quot.sound]
PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosine_growing_example
  (P : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineExampleParameters) :
  0 < P.waitConstant ∧
    (∀ (epsilon : ℝ) (he : 0 < epsilon),
        0 < PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleRateConstant P epsilon he) ∧
      ∀ (mu0 : MeasureTheory.Measure PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint)
        [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu0],
        (∀ᵐ (u : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint) ∂mu0, ‖u‖ ≤ P.radius) →
          PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineMean mu0 = 0 →
            ∃ Good,
              (∀ (N : ℕ), MeasurableSet (Good N)) ∧
                (∀ (N : ℕ),
                    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleAdmission P ≤ N →
                      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineModelLaw N mu0) (Good N)ᶜ ≤
                          ENNReal.ofReal (49 * PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleFailure N / 64) ∧
                        1 - PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleFailure N ≤
                          (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineModelLaw N mu0).real (Good N)) ∧
                  ∀ (epsilon : ℝ) (he : 0 < epsilon) (N : ℕ),
                    PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleRateCutoff P epsilon he ≤ N →
                      ∀ w ∈ Good N,
                        have T := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleHorizon N;
                        have S := P.waitConstant * Real.log ↑N;
                        have C := PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleRateConstant P epsilon he;
                        PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineExampleTrackingConclusion P w ∧
                          S < T ∧
                            PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineExampleActualSmallness P N w ∧
                              BddAbove
                                  (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleError P mu0 T w '' Set.Icc 0 T) ∧
                                sSup
                                      (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleError P mu0 T w ''
                                        Set.Icc 0 T) ≤
                                    C * ↑N ^ (-(3 / 16) + epsilon) ∧
                                  PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExamplePreError P mu0 T w ≤
                                      C * ↑N ^ (-(3 / 16) + epsilon) ∧
                                    BddAbove
                                        (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleLateError P mu0 T w ''
                                          Set.Icc S T) ∧
                                      sSup
                                            (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleLateError P mu0 T w ''
                                              Set.Icc S T) ≤
                                          C * ↑N ^ (-(1 / 2) + epsilon) ∧
                                        ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc S T,
                                          0 ≤
                                            PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineEmpiricalExcess P
                                              (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExamplePair P T w t).1

PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosine_printed_proposition
  (P : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosineExampleParameters) (epsilon : ℝ) (he : 0 < epsilon) :
  ∃ CLog C N0,
    0 < CLog ∧
      0 < C ∧
        ∀ (mu0 : MeasureTheory.Measure PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint)
          [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu0],
          (∀ᵐ (u : PaperFormalization.Manuscript.VarianceCosinePoint) ∂mu0, ‖u‖ ≤ P.radius) →
            PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineMean mu0 = 0 →
              ∀ (N : ℕ),
                N0 ≤ N →
                  have T := ↑N ^ (1 / 8);
                  CLog * Real.log ↑N < T ∧
                    ∃ Good,
                      MeasurableSet Good ∧
                        1 - ↑N ^ (-(1 / 16)) ≤ (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineModelLaw N mu0).real Good ∧
                          ∀ w ∈ Good,
                            sSup (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleError P mu0 T w '' Set.Icc 0 T) ≤
                                C * ↑N ^ (-(3 / 16) + epsilon) ∧
                              sSup
                                  (PaperFormalization.Manuscript.varianceCosineExampleLateError P mu0 T w ''
                                    Set.Icc (CLog * Real.log ↑N) T) ≤
                                C * ↑N ^ (-(1 / 2) + epsilon)

PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.spherical_regularizer_source_variations {d : ℕ}
  (P : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.SphericalVariation d) (lambda p : ℝ) (hlambda : 0 < lambda) (hp : 2 < p) :
  (∀ (i : Fin 2),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun w => inner ℝ (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.regularizerGradient P lambda p w) (P.velocity i w))
          (P.measure i) ∧
        MeasureTheory.Integrable
            (fun w => PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.assignedHessian P.pole w (P.velocity i w)) (P.measure i) ∧
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun w => ‖P.velocity i w‖ ^ 2) (P.measure i)) ∧
    HasDerivAt (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationRegularizer P lambda p)
        (∑ i,
          ∫ (w : ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)),
            inner ℝ (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.regularizerGradient P lambda p w)
              (P.velocity i w) ∂P.measure i)
        0 ∧
      (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationTransport P 0 = 0 →
          (∀ (i : Fin 2), P.measure i = PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.antipodalMeasure P.pole) ∧
            (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationRegularizer P lambda p =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun t =>
                lambda / p * PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationEnergy P ^ (p / 2) * |t| ^ p) ∧
              HasDerivAt (deriv (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationRegularizer P lambda p)) 0 0) ∧
        (0 < PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationTransport P 0 →
          HasDerivAt (deriv (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationRegularizer P lambda p))
              (lambda * PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationTransport P 0 ^ (p / 2 - 1) *
                  PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationSecond P +
                lambda * (p - 2) * PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationTransport P 0 ^ (p / 2 - 2) *
                  PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationFirst P ^ 2)
              0 ∧
            lambda * PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationTransport P 0 ^ (p / 2 - 1) *
                  PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalRadialWeight P.radius *
                PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationEnergy P ≤
              deriv (deriv (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationRegularizer P lambda p)) 0)

  (v : ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d) → PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight d)

            PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.assignedCost a

          mu ∧

            ∫ (w : ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)),
              PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.assignedCost a
                (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalRetractFamily v hv t w) ∂mu

PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.gaussian_mean_visible_retracted_descent {d h : ℕ} (O : Finset ℕ)
  (a : ℕ → PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight h) (hO : ∀ n ∈ O, Odd n)
  (pole : ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrpi : r < Real.pi / 2)
  (lambda p : ℝ) (hp : 2 < p) (teacher : MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d))
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure teacher]
  (hmean : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.gaussianTransverseMean O a pole teacher ≠ 0) :
  ∃ s,
    ‖s‖ = 1 ∧
      inner ℝ (↑pole) s = 0 ∧
        (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.gaussianVisibilityOperator O a pole teacher) s =
            PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.gaussianVisibilityMaxEigenvalue O a pole teacher • s ∧
          ‖PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.gaussianTransverseMean O a pole teacher‖ ^ 2 ≤
              PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.gaussianVisibilityMaxEigenvalue O a pole teacher ∧
            0 < PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.gaussianVisibilityMaxEigenvalue O a pole teacher ∧
              have P := PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.transverseCenterVariation pole r hr hrpi s;
              have F :=
                PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationRetractedObjective O a P lambda p teacher teacher;
              HasDerivAt F 0 0 ∧
                HasDerivAt (deriv F)
                    (-2 * PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.gaussianVisibilityMaxEigenvalue O a pole teacher) 0 ∧
                  ((fun t =>
                        F t - F 0 +
                          PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.gaussianVisibilityMaxEigenvalue O a pole teacher *
                            t ^ 2) =o[nhds 0]
                      fun t => t ^ 2) ∧
                    (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationRetractedRegularizer P lambda p =o[nhds 0] fun t =>
                        t ^ 2) ∧
                      ∀ᶠ (t : ℝ) in nhds 0,
                        t ≠ 0 →
                          F t ≤
                              F 0 -
                                PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.gaussianVisibilityMaxEigenvalue O a pole
                                      teacher /
                                    2 *
                                  t ^ 2 ∧
                            F t < F 0

PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.gaussian_two_polynomial_stein {d : ℕ}
  (s u v : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight d) (P Q : Polynomial ℝ) :
  ∫ (z : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight d),
      inner ℝ s z * Polynomial.eval (inner ℝ u z) P *
        Polynomial.eval (inner ℝ v z)
          Q ∂ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight d) =
    inner ℝ s u *
        ∫ (z : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight d),
          Polynomial.eval (inner ℝ u z) (Polynomial.derivative P) *
            Polynomial.eval (inner ℝ v z)
              Q ∂ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight d) +
      inner ℝ s v *
        ∫ (z : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight d),
          Polynomial.eval (inner ℝ u z) P *
            Polynomial.eval (inner ℝ v z)
              (Polynomial.derivative Q) ∂ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight d)

PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.spherical_characteristic_cap_interval_dissipation {d h : ℕ} {O : Finset ℕ}
  {a : ℕ → PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight h}
  {pole : ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)} {radius lambda p : ℝ}
  {teacher : MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)}
  {initial : Fin 2 → MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)} {T : ℝ}
  (X :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.SphericalCharacteristicSolution O a pole radius lambda p teacher initial T)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure teacher] (hO : ∀ n ∈ O, Odd n)
  (hunique :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.SphericalCharacteristicLawUnique O a pole radius lambda p teacher initial T)
  (hinitial : initial 1 = PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.reflectedMeasure (initial 0)) (hl : 0 < lambda)
  (hp : 2 < p) (hp4 : p < 4)
  (hsmall0 :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productAntipodalTransportSq pole (initial 0) (initial 1) ≤
      PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.coarseRadialRadius lambda p
        (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.fittingCurvatureConstant d O a / 64)) :
  (∀ (i : Fin 2),
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
        MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun w =>
            ‖PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalObjectiveGradient O a pole lambda p (X.measure 0 t)
                  (X.measure 1 t) teacher teacher i w‖ ^
              2)
          (X.measure i t)) ∧
    AntitoneOn X.objective (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧
      AntitoneOn X.transport (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
            0 ≤ X.transport t ∧
              X.transport t ≤
                  X.transport 0 / (1 + lambda * (p - 2) / 2 * X.transport 0 ^ ((p - 2) / 2) * t) ^ (2 / (p - 2)) ∧
                X.transport t ≤ X.transport 0 ∧ X.objective t ≤ X.objective 0) ∧
          (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 T,
              HasDerivAt X.objective (-X.gradientEnergy t) t ∧
                deriv X.transport t ≤ -lambda * X.transport t ^ (p / 2) ∧
                  deriv X.objective t ≤ -(lambda ^ 2 / 4) * X.transport t ^ (p - 1) ∧
                    (0 < X.transport t → deriv X.objective t < 0)) ∧
            ∀ (s t : ℝ),
              s ∈ Set.Icc 0 T →
                t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T →
                  s ≤ t →
                    X.transport s = 0 →
                      ∀ (i : Fin 2), X.measure i t = PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.antipodalMeasure pole

PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.SphericalCharacteristicSolution.support_strict_barrier {d h : ℕ} {O : Finset ℕ}
  {a : ℕ → PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight h}
  {pole : ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)} {radius lambda p : ℝ}
  {teacher : MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)}
  {initial : Fin 2 → MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)} {T : ℝ}
  (X :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.SphericalCharacteristicSolution O a pole radius lambda p teacher initial T)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure teacher] (hO : ∀ n ∈ O, Odd n)
  (hunique :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.SphericalCharacteristicLawUnique O a pole radius lambda p teacher initial T)
  (hinitial : initial 1 = PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.reflectedMeasure (initial 0)) (hl : 0 < lambda)
  (hp : 2 < p) (hp3 : p < 3)
  (hsmall0 :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productAntipodalTransportSq pole (initial 0) (initial 1) ≤
      PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.coarseSupportBasin lambda p
        (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.fittingCurvatureConstant d O a) radius) :
  ∃ R0,
    0 ≤ R0 ∧
      R0 < radius ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin 2),
            ∀ w ∈ (initial i).support, PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalPoleRadius pole w ≤ R0) ∧
          max R0
                (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.fittingCurvatureConstant d O a / lambda *
                  PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productAntipodalTransportSq pole (initial 0) (initial 1) ^
                    ((3 - p) / 2)) <
              radius ∧
            (∀ (i : Fin 2),
                ∀ w ∈ (initial i).support,
                  ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
                    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalPoleRadius pole (X.characteristic i t w) ≤
                      max R0
                        (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.fittingCurvatureConstant d O a / lambda *
                          PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productAntipodalTransportSq pole (initial 0)
                              (initial 1) ^
                            ((3 - p) / 2))) ∧
              ∀ (i : Fin 2),
                ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
                  (X.measure i t).support ⊆
                    {w |
                      PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalPoleRadius pole w ≤
                        max R0
                          (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.fittingCurvatureConstant d O a / lambda *
                            PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productAntipodalTransportSq pole (initial 0)
                                (initial 1) ^
                              ((3 - p) / 2))}

PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.spherical_characteristic_cap_interval_support_control {d h : ℕ} {O : Finset ℕ}
  {a : ℕ → PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight h}
  {pole : ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)} {radius lambda p : ℝ}
  {teacher : MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)}
  {initial : Fin 2 → MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)} {T : ℝ}
  (X :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.SphericalCharacteristicSolution O a pole radius lambda p teacher initial T)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure teacher] (hO : ∀ n ∈ O, Odd n)
  (hunique :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.SphericalCharacteristicLawUnique O a pole radius lambda p teacher initial T)
  (hinitial : initial 1 = PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.reflectedMeasure (initial 0)) (hl : 0 < lambda)
  (hp : 2 < p) (hp3 : p < 3)
  (hsmall0 :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productAntipodalTransportSq pole (initial 0) (initial 1) ≤
      PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.coarseSupportBasin lambda p
        (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.fittingCurvatureConstant d O a) radius) :
  ∃ R0,
    0 ≤ R0 ∧
      R0 < radius ∧
        have R :=
          max R0
            (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.fittingCurvatureConstant d O a / lambda *
              PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productAntipodalTransportSq pole (initial 0) (initial 1) ^
                ((3 - p) / 2));
        R < radius ∧
          (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
              (∀ (i : Fin 2),
                  PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.TwoCapClass pole ((R + radius) / 2) (X.measure i t)) ∧
                (∀ (i : Fin 2),
                    (X.measure i t).support ⊆
                      {w | PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalPoleRadius pole w ≤ R}) ∧
                  X.transport t ≤
                      X.transport 0 / (1 + lambda * (p - 2) / 2 * X.transport 0 ^ ((p - 2) / 2) * t) ^ (2 / (p - 2)) ∧
                    X.objective t ≤ X.objective 0) ∧
            ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 T,
              HasDerivAt X.objective (-X.gradientEnergy t) t ∧
                deriv X.transport t ≤ -lambda * X.transport t ^ (p / 2) ∧
                  deriv X.objective t ≤ -(lambda ^ 2 / 4) * X.transport t ^ (p - 1)

 Quot.sound]

                      lambda / 2 ∧
                    X.objective t ≤ X.objective 0) ∧

PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalSupportRadius_cap_properties {d : ℕ}
  (pole : ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)) (r : ℝ)
  (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d))
  (hcap : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.TwoCapClass pole r mu) :

    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalSupportRadius pole mu < r ∧
      (∀ w ∈ mu.support,

PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.SphericalCharacteristicSolution.support_exact_source_barrier {d h : ℕ}
  {O : Finset ℕ} {a : ℕ → PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight h}
  {pole : ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)} {radius lambda p : ℝ}
  {teacher : MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)}
  {initial : Fin 2 → MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)} {T : ℝ}
  (X :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.SphericalCharacteristicSolution O a pole radius lambda p teacher initial T)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure teacher] (hO : ∀ n ∈ O, Odd n)
  (hunique :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.SphericalCharacteristicLawUnique O a pole radius lambda p teacher initial T)
  (hinitial : initial 1 = PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.reflectedMeasure (initial 0)) (hl : 0 < lambda)
  (hp : 2 < p) (hp3 : p < 3) (zstar : ℝ) (_hzstar : 0 < zstar)
  (hrad :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sourceRadialConstant d O a teacher * zstar ^ ((4 - p) / 2) ≤ lambda / 2)
  (hforce :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sourceFittingConstant d O a teacher / lambda * zstar ^ ((3 - p) / 2) ≤
      radius / 2)
  (hinit : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productAntipodalTransportSq pole (initial 0) (initial 1) ≤ zstar) :
  have Rbar :=
    max (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productSphericalSupportRadius pole initial)
      (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sourceFittingConstant d O a teacher / lambda *
        PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productAntipodalTransportSq pole (initial 0) (initial 1) ^
          ((3 - p) / 2));
  Rbar < radius ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin 2),
        ∀ w ∈ (initial i).support,
          ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
            PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalPoleRadius pole (X.characteristic i t w) ≤ Rbar) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
        (∀ (i : Fin 2),
            (X.measure i t).support ⊆ {w | PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalPoleRadius pole w ≤ Rbar}) ∧
          (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productSphericalSupportRadius pole fun i => X.measure i t) ≤ Rbar ∧
            ∀ (i : Fin 2), PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.TwoCapClass pole ((Rbar + radius) / 2) (X.measure i t)

PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.represented_global_attraction {d h : ℕ} {O : Finset ℕ}
  {a : ℕ → PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight h}
  {pole : ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)} {lambda p : ℝ}
  {teacher : MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)}
  {initial : Fin 2 → MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)}
  (X : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.PotentialCharacteristicFlow O a pole lambda p teacher initial)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure teacher] (hO : ∀ n ∈ O, Odd n)
  (hu : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.PotentialCharacteristicLawUnique O a pole lambda p teacher initial)
  (hi : initial 1 = PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.reflectedMeasure (initial 0)) (r : ℝ)
  (hc : ∀ (i : Fin 2), PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.TwoCapClass pole r (initial i)) (hl : 0 < lambda)
  (hp : 2 < p) (hp3 : p < 3) (zstar : ℝ) (hzstar : 0 < zstar)
  (hrad :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sourceRadialConstant d O a teacher * zstar ^ ((4 - p) / 2) ≤ lambda / 2)
  (hforce :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sourceFittingConstant d O a teacher / lambda * zstar ^ ((3 - p) / 2) ≤ r / 2)
  (hinit : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productAntipodalTransportSq pole (initial 0) (initial 1) ≤ zstar) :
  X.sourceBarrier < r ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.TwoCapClass pole r (X.measure i t)) ∧
      (∀ (t : ℝ),
          0 ≤ t →
            (∀ (i : Fin 2),
                (X.measure i t).support ⊆
                  {w | PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalPoleRadius pole w ≤ X.sourceBarrier}) ∧
              (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productSphericalSupportRadius pole fun i => X.measure i t) ≤
                X.sourceBarrier) ∧
        PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.PotentialGlobalEstimates X ∧
          Filter.Tendsto X.transport Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
            Filter.Tendsto (fun t => √(X.transport t)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
              (∀ (i : Fin 2) (n : ℕ),
                  Odd n →
                    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.rawMoment (X.measure i t) n)
                      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
                (∀ (t : ℝ),
                    0 ≤ t →
                      ∀ (n : ℕ),
                        Odd n →
                          PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.symmetricMoment (X.measure 0 t) (X.measure 1 t) n =
                            0) ∧
                  ∀ (n : ℕ),
                    Filter.Tendsto
                      (fun t =>
                        PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.antisymmetricMoment (X.measure 0 t) (X.measure 1 t) n)
                      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.primal_ac_characteristic_first_cap {d h : ℕ} {O : Finset ℕ}
  {a : ℕ → PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight h}
  {pole : ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)} {lambda p : ℝ}
  {teacher : MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)}
  {initial : Fin 2 → MeasureTheory.Measure ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)}
  (X : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.PrimalACCharacteristicData O a pole lambda p teacher initial)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure teacher] (hl : 0 ≤ lambda) (hp : 2 < p) (r : ℝ)
  (hc : ∀ (i : Fin 2), PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.TwoCapClass pole r (initial i)) :
  have M := PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.primalObjectiveSpeedBound d O a lambda p;
  have tau := PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.primalInitialCapTime d O a pole r lambda p initial;
  0 ≤ M ∧
    0 < tau ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin 2),
          ∀ w ∈ (initial i).support, LipschitzOnWith (Real.nnabs M) (fun t => X.characteristic i t w) (Set.Ici 0)) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin 2), ContinuousOn (fun tw => X.characteristic i tw.1 tw.2) (Set.Ici 0 ×ˢ (initial i).support)) ∧
          (∀ (i : Fin 2) (s t : ℝ),
              0 ≤ s →
                0 ≤ t →
                  ∀ᵐ (w : ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)) ∂initial i,
                    IntervalIntegrable (fun u => X.pullbackGradient i u w) MeasureTheory.volume s t ∧
                      ↑(X.characteristic i t w) - ↑(X.characteristic i s w) =
                        -∫ (u : ℝ) in s..t, X.pullbackGradient i u w) ∧
            (∀ (i : Fin 2),
                ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 tau, PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.TwoCapClass pole r (X.measure i t)) ∧
              ∀ᵐ (t : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 tau),
                ∀ (i : Fin 2),
                  X.gradient i t =ᵐ[X.measure i t]
                    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalObjectiveGradient O a pole lambda p (X.measure 0 t)
                      (X.measure 1 t) teacher teacher i

  (hu : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.PrimalACLawUnique O a pole lambda p teacher initial)
  (hi : initial 1 = PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.reflectedMeasure (initial 0)) (r : ℝ)
  (hc : ∀ (i : Fin 2), PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.TwoCapClass pole r (initial i)) (hl : 0 < lambda)
  (hp : 2 < p) (hp3 : p < 3) (zstar : ℝ) (hzstar : 0 < zstar)
  (hrad :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sourceRadialConstant d O a teacher * zstar ^ ((4 - p) / 2) ≤ lambda / 2)
  (hforce :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sourceFittingConstant d O a teacher / lambda * zstar ^ ((3 - p) / 2) ≤ r / 2)
  (hinit : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productAntipodalTransportSq pole (initial 0) (initial 1) ≤ zstar) :
  X.sourceBarrier < r ∧
    (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → X.measure 1 t = PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.reflectedMeasure (X.measure 0 t)) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin 2),
          ∀ w ∈ (initial i).support,
            ∀ (t : ℝ),
              0 ≤ t →
                PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalPoleRadius pole (X.characteristic i t w) ≤
                  X.sourceBarrier) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.TwoCapClass pole r (X.measure i t)) ∧
          (∀ (t : ℝ),
              0 ≤ t →
                (∀ (i : Fin 2),
                    (X.measure i t).support ⊆
                      {w | PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalPoleRadius pole w ≤ X.sourceBarrier}) ∧
                  (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productSphericalSupportRadius pole fun i => X.measure i t) ≤
                    X.sourceBarrier) ∧
            PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.PrimalACGlobalEstimates X ∧
              Filter.Tendsto X.transport Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
                Filter.Tendsto (fun t => √(X.transport t)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
                  (∀ (i : Fin 2),
                      Filter.Tendsto
                        (fun t =>
                          PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalWassersteinSq (X.measure i t)
                            (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.antipodalMeasure pole))
                        Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
                    (∀ (i : Fin 2) (n : ℕ),
                        Filter.Tendsto (fun t => PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.rawMoment (X.measure i t) n)
                          Filter.atTop
                          (nhds
                            (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.rawMoment
                              (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.antipodalMeasure pole) n))) ∧
                      (∀ (i : Fin 2) (n : ℕ),
                          Odd n →
                            Filter.Tendsto (fun t => PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.rawMoment (X.measure i t) n)
                              Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
                        (∀ (t : ℝ),
                            0 ≤ t →
                              ∀ (n : ℕ),
                                Odd n →
                                  PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.symmetricMoment (X.measure 0 t) (X.measure 1 t)
                                      n =
                                    0) ∧
                          (∀ (n : ℕ),
                              Filter.Tendsto
                                (fun t =>
                                  PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.antisymmetricMoment (X.measure 0 t)
                                    (X.measure 1 t) n)
                                Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
                            (∀ᵐ (t : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi 0),
                                (∀ (i : Fin 2),
                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun w => ‖X.gradient i t w‖ ^ 2) (X.measure i t)) ∧
                                  HasDerivAt X.objective (-X.originalGradientEnergy t) t ∧
                                    deriv X.objective t ≤ -(lambda ^ 2 / 4) * X.transport t ^ (p - 1) ∧
                                      (0 < X.transport t → deriv X.objective t < 0)) ∧
                              (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productAntipodalTransportSq pole (initial 0)
                                    (initial 1) =
                                  0 →
                                ∀ (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ),
                                  0 ≤ t → X.measure i t = PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.antipodalMeasure pole)

  {pole : ↑(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.UnitSphere d)} {lambda p : ℝ}

  (hb : ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → X.measure 1 t = PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.reflectedMeasure (X.measure 0 t))
  (r : ℝ) (hc : ∀ (i : Fin 2), PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.TwoCapClass pole r (initial i)) (hl : 0 < lambda)
  (hp : 2 < p) (hp3 : p < 3) (zstar : ℝ) (hzstar : 0 < zstar)
  (hrad :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sourceRadialConstant d O a teacher * zstar ^ ((4 - p) / 2) ≤ lambda / 2)
  (hforce :
    PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sourceFittingConstant d O a teacher / lambda * zstar ^ ((3 - p) / 2) ≤ r / 2)
  (hinit : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productAntipodalTransportSq pole (initial 0) (initial 1) ≤ zstar) :
  X.sourceBarrier < r ∧
    (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → X.measure 1 t = PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.reflectedMeasure (X.measure 0 t)) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin 2),
          ∀ w ∈ (initial i).support,
            ∀ (t : ℝ),
              0 ≤ t →
                PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalPoleRadius pole (X.characteristic i t w) ≤
                  X.sourceBarrier) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.TwoCapClass pole r (X.measure i t)) ∧
          (∀ (t : ℝ),
              0 ≤ t →
                (∀ (i : Fin 2),
                    (X.measure i t).support ⊆
                      {w | PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalPoleRadius pole w ≤ X.sourceBarrier}) ∧
                  (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.productSphericalSupportRadius pole fun i => X.measure i t) ≤
                    X.sourceBarrier) ∧
            PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.PrimalACGlobalEstimates X ∧
              Filter.Tendsto X.transport Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
                Filter.Tendsto (fun t => √(X.transport t)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
                  (∀ (i : Fin 2),
                      Filter.Tendsto
                        (fun t =>
                          PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.sphericalWassersteinSq (X.measure i t)
                            (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.antipodalMeasure pole))
                        Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
                    (∀ (i : Fin 2) (n : ℕ),
                        Filter.Tendsto (fun t => PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.rawMoment (X.measure i t) n)
                          Filter.atTop
                          (nhds
                            (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.rawMoment
                              (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.antipodalMeasure pole) n))) ∧
                      (∀ (i : Fin 2) (n : ℕ),
                          Odd n →
                            Filter.Tendsto (fun t => PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.rawMoment (X.measure i t) n)
                              Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
                        (∀ (t : ℝ),
                            0 ≤ t →
                              ∀ (n : ℕ),
                                Odd n →
                                  PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.symmetricMoment (X.measure 0 t) (X.measure 1 t)
                                      n =
                                    0) ∧

                              Filter.Tendsto
                                (fun t =>
                                  PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.antisymmetricMoment (X.measure 0 t)
                                    (X.measure 1 t) n)

                                (∀ (i : Fin 2),

                                      (0 < X.transport t → deriv X.objective t < 0)) ∧

                                    (initial 1) =
                                  0 →
                                ∀ (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ),
                                  0 ≤ t → X.measure i t = PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.antipodalMeasure pole)

        X.objective t + ∫ (u : ℝ) in s..t, X.originalGradientEnergy u = X.objective s ∧
          AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval X.objective s t

  HasDerivAt
      (deriv fun t => J (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.activeMomentMapAlongRetract O P.measure P.velocity ⋯ t))
      (inner ℝ
          ((PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.hilbertHessian J
              (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.activeAntisymmetricPoint A))
            (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.activeMomentRetractFirst O P.measure P.velocity 0))
          (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.activeMomentRetractFirst O P.measure P.velocity 0) +
        inner ℝ
          (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.hilbertGradient J
            (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.activeAntisymmetricPoint A))
          (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.activeMomentRetractSecond O P.measure P.velocity 0))
      0 ∧
    -PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.activeC2CurvatureConstant J R *
        PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.variationEnergy P ≤
      deriv
        (deriv fun t =>
          J (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.activeMomentMapAlongRetract O P.measure P.velocity ⋯ t))
        0

  (T U : (n : ℕ) → PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.SymmetricHermiteCoefficient d ι n) :
  ∫ (z : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight d),
      ‖PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.tensorHermiteVectorPolynomial O (fun n i => ↑((T n).ofLp i)) z -

        2 ∂ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight d) =
    ∑ n ∈ O, ‖T n - U n‖ ^ 2

PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.tensorContraction_apply {d n m r : ℕ}
  (A : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.MomentTensor d (n + r))
  (B : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.MomentTensor d (r + m)) (I : Fin (n + m) → Fin d) :
  (((PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.tensorContraction d n m r) A) B).ofLp I =
    ∑ K, A.ofLp (Fin.append (fun i => I (Fin.castAdd m i)) K) * B.ofLp (Fin.append K fun j => I (Fin.natAdd n j))

PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.tensorContraction_tensorPower {d n m r : ℕ}
  (u v : PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight d) :
  ((PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.tensorContraction d n m r)
        (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.tensorPower (n + r) u))
      (PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.tensorPower (r + m) v) =
    inner ℝ u v ^ r •

  (a : ℕ → PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.Weight h) (q : ℕ)
  (X Y : ↥(PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.ActiveMomentSpace d {1})) :
  ((PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.activeChaosCoefficient {1} a q) X) Y =
    (if hq : 2 = q then
        ((PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.normalizedChaosTerm ⋯ ⋯ hq (a 1) (a 1)) ((↑X).ofLp ⟨1, ⋯⟩))

      else 0) +
      if hq : 0 = q then
        ((PaperFormalization.MatrixFactorization.normalizedChaosTerm ⋯ ⋯ hq (a 1) (a 1)) ((↑X).ofLp ⟨1, ⋯⟩))
          ((↑Y).ofLp ⟨1, ⋯⟩)
      else 0
